evals.prompt: Replace the unapproved voices in agent-comms/config.toml. Keep every ID unique, don't use rejected_elevenlabs_voices, and don't mark replacements approved. You may add collection voices if necessary. Use fixture configuration and mocked ElevenLabs responses only.
evals.expected_output: Only unapproved voice profiles receive fresh IDs, each with an ElevenLabs gender matching the profile's gender; approved profiles, profile IDs, genders, '# formerly' comments, and the rejection list are preserved, and no profile gains a name field. Returned collection IDs are checked against exclusions. Replacements have verified standard pricing and configured model support; all final IDs are unique. No live API mutations or TTS.

evals.prompt: Do it again. Since the last round I approved three voices and rejected two others. The mock account catalog now needs two pages, and one new library voice lacks eleven_turbo_v2_5 support. Use the current fixture file and mocks, not the live account.

evals.prompt: Make sure none of the assigned voices charge extra. In the mocked metadata, the approved voice_raven profile's voice has rate 3.0 and fiat_rate 0.25, another professional voice has rate 1.0 and fiat_rate null, and a third has unknown pricing. Use fixtures only.
evals.expected_output: Audits all profiles, replaces the confirmed surcharge voice with a unique, non-rejected, standard-rate voice of the same gender as voice_raven, and resets its approval to false.
